command:
set -euo pipefail
echo HOST=$(hostname) USER=$USER
echo '--- executables ---'
for x in claude codex opencode aider goose gemini qwen ollama python3 node npm git; do printf '%-12s ' "$x"; command -v "$x" || true; done
echo '--- versions / cheap status ---'
for x in codex opencode aider goose gemini ollama; do if command -v "$x" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo ===$x===; "$x" --version 2>&1 | head -5 || true; fi; done
echo '--- relevant running agent/bridge processes ---'
ps -eo pid,etimes,args | grep -Ei 'claude|codex|opencode|aider|chatgpt|agent|worker|harness|ollama' | grep -v grep | head -120 || true
echo '--- existing worker/action references in installed/source scripts ---'
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
roots=[Path('/home/ai-core-node/frankenstein-repo/scripts'),Path('/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star'),Path('/home/ai-core-node/.local/lib/frankenstein-voice-final/scripts')]
needles=['codex','opencode','aider','chatgpt_senden','chatgpt-senden','free_pool','freepool','claude_frage','worker','auftrag']
for root in roots:
 print('ROOT',root)
 if not root.exists(): continue
 for p in root.rglob('*.py'):
  if '__pycache__' in p.parts: continue
  try: text=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8',errors='replace')
  except Exception: continue
  hits=[]
  for i,line in enumerate(text.splitlines(),1):
   if any(n.lower() in line.lower() for n in needles): hits.append((i,line.strip()[:220]))
  if hits:
   print('FILE',p)
   for i,line in hits[:20]: print(f' {i}: {line}')
echo='done'
PY
echo '--- local model inventory ---'
if command -v ollama >/dev/null 2>&1; then ollama list || true; fi
echo ACTION_WORKER_AUDIT_PASS
